rapport_notes: Friendly and personable throughout, used customer's name repeatedly and kept a light tone.
process_discipline_notes: Damage/coverage differentiator was answered directly to the TV concern in Stage 1, then repeated nearly verbatim in the Stage 2 pricing pitch.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns for this move and you know, what are the most important things you'd like to get answers to on this call today?"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised pricing + TV-damage concern; rep answered both in one monologue ("Definitely not sir. We can definitely move the three televisions... we have this coverage") and pivoted straight to quid pro quo, no follow-up question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "there are a number of factors involved when determining move time. But the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there"

top_strength: Gave a clearly personalized time estimate (partial move, ground-floor apartment to one-story house) rather than a generic range.
coaching_note: Dig one layer deeper on raised concerns before pivoting to logistics, and cover the Communication differentiator (day-before call/crew lead), which was never mentioned.
